suite.doc:
System tests for the "Link/Unlink NFC Card" use case (included by Register Account).
Endpoints: POST /api/users/me/link-card — tell IoT to scan a card and link it to current user POST /api/users/me/unlink-card — remove the linked card from current user
Note: link-card waits for a real IoT hardware scan (15s timeout). The hardware-dependent path is covered by negative cases only (no hardware, 408 timeout or 409 already-linked) so these tests never require a physical kiosk to be present.
